item.title: [Due in 3 days] Alert tuning rules can be scoped to specific detection sources; existing rules keep applying to every source, custom detections included
item.description:
An alert tuning rule is a suppression rule. Today a rule written for one noisy Defender for Endpoint detection also suppresses a custom detection that happens to match the same conditions, and nobody sees the alert it hid.

Defender XDR · deadline 2026-11-08 · Before 8 November 2026, open every alert tuning rule, note which detection source it was written for and select that source; a rule you leave untouched keeps applying to all detection sources under its service sources, custom detections included.

item.title: [New] Microsoft Threat Intelligence: fake-download campaign drops proxyware, BOINC miners and adware from trojanized Inno Setup installers
item.description:
Proxyware turns a managed endpoint into an exit node for other people's traffic, so a SYSTEM scheduled task from a 'free' installer is an attribution and data-exposure problem, not just adware.

Threat Intel · Run the post's advanced hunting queries for the offer_execution callback and Inno temp-directory execution, audit SYSTEM scheduled tasks for WorldProxyPool, and confirm cloud-delivered protection, tamper protection and the relevant ASR rules are on.

item.title: [New] Defender for Endpoint on Linux 101.26101.0000 listed for November 2026 (engine 1.1.26090.3000, signatures 1.459.148.0)
item.description:
A new Linux sensor build reaches servers through the update channel; fleets pinned to older builds drift out of the supported window.

MDE · Check the Linux fleet's version spread in the Defender device inventory and plan the move to 101.26101.0000 through the normal ring.

item.title: [New] Defender RBAC is switched on automatically for Defender and Sentinel portal experiences, about 30 days after an in-portal notice, from early December 2026
item.description:
After activation, Defender and Sentinel portal access is decided by imported Defender RBAC roles, not by the legacy workload roles a SOC audited; an import that maps an analyst too broadly or too narrowly changes incident and email access without any new grant being made.

Defender XDR · When the banner appears, review every imported role and scope under Permissions > Roles in the Defender portal, test an analyst and a Security Reader account against email, device and Sentinel views, move any role automation to the Defender RBAC Graph API, and update runbooks before 2 December 2026.

item.description:
Microsoft Defender RBAC will be auto-enabled in your tenant starting December 2026, unifying access management for Defender and Sentinel. Existing roles will be imported for review before activation about 30 days after notification. Adjust roles as needed; opt-out is available post-activation. Other Microsoft service permissions remain unchanged.

Microsoft Defender XDR · planForChange · act by 2026-12-02

item.description:
Microsoft Defender has expanded Unified role-based access control (URBAC) permissions for email content access to include alerts related to potentially malicious URL clicks. Security analysts with the appropriate permission can now preview and download emails from four alert types, ensuring consistent access across scenarios.

item.description:

Defender XDR · Check which Defender URBAC custom roles carry 'Emails associated with alerts' and grant it to the analysts who triage URL-click alerts; keep it off roles that should not read mail content.

item.title: [New] Microsoft Threat Intelligence analyses a malicious Claude Code-branded editor extension that plants a persistent SSH backdoor
item.description:
Developer workstations hold cloud tokens and signing keys; an AI-assistant lookalike extension with SSH persistence gives an attacker a durable foothold that endpoint baselines rarely watch.

Threat Intel · Read the post's detection and remediation guidance, inventory editor extensions on developer devices, and hunt for unexpected SSH authorized_keys changes or new SSH listeners on them.

item.description:
Teams-call vishing and help-desk impersonation from external tenants had no hunting table of its own; this one gives the initiator's tenant and membership type, the fields an external-impersonation detection needs.

Defender XDR · Review the CallActivityEvents schema on Learn, plan a detection for external-tenant initiators joined to MessageEvents on ThreadId, and check that the Sentinel or streaming-API ingestion picks the table up once it appears.

Available worldwide from November 2026, it integrates with advanced hunting, event streaming API, and Microsoft Sentinel for enhanced threat detection.
